Running it
----------
simcity.ldf is a disk image for a Camputers Lynx 128K with its disk
interface (or an emulator of one: in MAME, lynx128k with the image in the
first floppy drive).  Start the machine, then type

    XROM
    EXT BOOT

The game loads from the disk (a few seconds: the program, then its
pictures, which go into the alternate green plane of the video RAM) and
starts at the title screen: no CP/M disk is needed.  The 48K and 96K
Lynx do not have the memory.

The game uses the 512 x 252 screen in eight colours as a grid of 32 by 25
cells.  Sound is made by the CPU through the DAC, so the game waits while
an effect plays (up to two seconds for a crash; the earthquake rumbles for
a few).  The Sound option in the game menu turns it off.  Cities are saved
to and loaded from the same disk, in one of eight slots after the game
itself (so the disk must not be write protected, and the image file is
changed when you save).  The map is 96 x 96 squares and there are no
scenarios.

This has been run only in MAME: the disk timing, the sound pitch (it
assumes a 6 MHz Z80) and whether the speaker needs enabling on the real
machine are untested.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
